title: Broken Hoppers
description: Hoppers destroy themselves whenever you try to use them.
body:
## What does the plugin do
Whenever a hopper is used to move an item, the hopper breaks instantly and drops everything it had inside it.

## Why use this plugin
Some servers may not want hoppers to be used (ie for performance), this plugin renders hoppers useless so players won't use them, negating almost all of the lag caused by hoppers.
